name: Gitea 28 Git Forge
description: Self-hosted Git service: repos, pull requests, issues, packages, SSH

PORT.description: Port Gitea's web server listens on (Railway's healthcheck and domain use it).

GITEA_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: First administrator, created on the first boot. An invalid or reserved name falls back to gitea-admin.

GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of the first administrator (at least 8 characters). Used only when no admin exists, or with GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD_RESET=true.

GITEA_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: E-mail of the first administrator (change it later in your profile).

GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD_RESET.description: true = set the admin's password to GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD on the next boot (recovery). Set back to false afterwards.

GITEA__DEFAULT__APP_NAME.description: Instance name shown in the page title and e-mails.

GITEA__server__DOMAIN.description: Public hostname. Change it (and ROOT_URL) when you add a custom domain.

GITEA__server__ROOT_URL.description: Public URL used in links, clone URLs, OAuth and webhooks.

GITEA__server__HTTP_PORT.description: Port of the web server (keep equal to PORT).

GITEA__server__SSH_DOMAIN.description: Host shown in SSH clone URLs (Railway TCP proxy).

GITEA__server__SSH_PORT.description: Port shown in SSH clone URLs (Railway TCP proxy port).

GITEA__server__SSH_LISTEN_PORT.description: Port OpenSSH listens on inside the container (the TCP proxy targets 22).

SSH_LISTEN_PORT.description: Port the image's OpenSSH config is written with (keep 22, the TCP proxy target).

GITEA__server__LFS_START_SERVER.description: Serve Git LFS (objects are stored on the volume).

GITEA__database__HOST.description: Postgres host:port on the private network.

GITEA__database__SSL_MODE.description: Postgres TLS mode (private network traffic is already encrypted by Railway).

GITEA__database__DB_RETRIES.description: Connection attempts at startup while Postgres boots (3 s apart).

GITEA__security__INSTALL_LOCK.description: Skip the web installer: everything is configured from these variables.

GITEA__security__SECRET_KEY.description: Encrypts 2FA secrets and other data in the database. Never change it after the first boot.

GITEA__service__DISABLE_REGISTRATION.description: true = only admins create accounts (Site administration > User accounts). false opens sign-up to anyone.

GITEA__service__REQUIRE_SIGNIN_VIEW.description: true = visitors must sign in to see anything, including public repositories.

GITEA__service__DEFAULT_KEEP_EMAIL_PRIVA.description: Hide e-mail addresses of new users by default.

GITEA__log__LEVEL.description: Log level (Trace, Debug, Info, Warn, Error).

GITEA__mailer__ENABLED.description: true + the GITEA__mailer__* settings to send e-mail (outbound SMTP needs Railway Pro; see README).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds Gitea gets to finish requests and close the database on redeploy.

PGDATA.description: Location where the database is initialized (inside the volume).

PGUSER.description: User for the Railway Data panel.

PGDATABASE.description: Database for the Railway Data panel.

PGPASSWORD.description: Password for the Railway Data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Database created on the first boot (Gitea's database).

SSL_CERT_DAYS.description: Validity of the self-signed TLS certificate in days.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds Postgres gets to shut down cleanly on redeploy.
